start: Signed in as the owner; gym whose server keeps photos; member page of a member with no photo (initials shown)

user_sees: Sheet titled "Take photo"
"Starting the camera… If the browser asks, tap Allow."
Then the camera picture with "Ask the member to look at the camera, with their face inside the oval."
"Only your gym’s staff can see this photo. It shows on the member’s page, their member card and at check-in."
must_not: The camera left on after the sheet is closed
The picture shown mirrored the wrong way

user_sees: The still picture
"Check that the face is clear. Tap Use photo to keep it."
Buttons to take it again and "Use photo"
must_not: A still that is flipped compared with the preview
"The photo was not taken. Try again." with no way to try again

user_sees: Button reads "Saving…"
Sheet closes
Toast "Photo saved."
The photo shows larger in place of the initials; the button now reads "Change photo"
must_not: "Photo saved." while the old initials stay
The photo saved on another member
Two uploads from two taps

start: Signed in as the owner; same page, the member brought a picture file

steps.action: Tap "Take photo", then "Upload a photo", and pick a JPG or PNG file
user_sees: The picked picture with "Use photo" and "Pick another"
must_not: A file that is not a picture accepted without a word

user_sees: Toast "Photo saved."
The photo in place of the initials
must_not: A huge file sent as it is so the save hangs
The page left with a broken-picture mark

start: Signed in as the owner; member page; the browser has refused the camera

user_sees: Plain words that the camera could not be used
Buttons "Try again" and "Upload a photo" (the upload button is the main one)
must_not: An endless "Starting camera…"
A blank sheet with no way on

steps.action: Tap "Upload a photo" and pick a file that is not a picture
user_sees: "That photo couldn’t be used. Pick a JPG or PNG picture."
must_not: The sheet closing as if it saved

steps.action: Open the member page in a gym whose server does not keep photos
user_sees: Only the initials; no "Take photo" button under them
must_not: A button that opens the camera and then cannot save

start: Signed in as the owner; member page of a member who has a photo (button reads "Change photo")

steps.action: Tap "Change photo", take a new one, tap "Use photo"
user_sees: Sheet titled "Change photo"
Toast "Photo saved."
The new photo on the page
must_not: The old photo still shown after a refresh
Both photos kept on the server

user_sees: Toast "Photo removed."
Initials again; the button reads "Take photo"
must_not: The photo still on the member card or at check-in
"The photo wasn’t removed. Try again." shown together with the photo gone

start: Signed in as the owner; member page; a photo was just saved

steps.action: Read the line in the camera sheet, then look for the photo: member page, member card, check-in, and the member's own phone app
user_sees: "Only your gym’s staff can see this photo. It shows on the member’s page, their member card and at check-in."
The photo in those three places in the panel
must_not: The photo shown to other members, on a public page or leaderboard
The photo readable by another gym
The photo kept on the server after "Remove photo"
